t: General purpose first aid kit, compact and versatile solution designed to address common injuries in various environments. Perfect for home, car, or travel use, to be prepared for unexpected situations. Packed in a durable Piccolo box, includes essential supplies like plasters, bandages, antiseptic wipes, and more, making it ideal for everyday emergencies. Easy to store, with robust design to keeps contents secure and organised, ready for immediate use when needed most.
b: Contents: Washproof Plasters (20), Scissors, Safety Pins (12), Saline Wipes (6), Medium Dressings / Eyepad & Bandages / Pairs of Gloves / Aprons (2), Non-Adherent Dressings 5x5cm (4), Microporous Tape
